title: Corroded Reese
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A low-register Reese bass built from a detuned supersaw driven through a resonant ladder filter envelope, growling and roaring as the cutoff and detune breathe on slow LFOs. Across the 32-cycle loop a degradation arc ramps in crush and coarse downsampling, so the clean roar slowly corrodes into a broken, dirty machine and then resets.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 [f1 g1] c1 ab0 ab0 [c1 db1] f1>*2").s("supersaw")
    .detune(sine.slow(16).range(0.12, 0.55))
    .unison(3)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(180, 2400)).resonance(sine.slow(19).range(8, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(32).range(2, 6)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.12).lpsustain(0.4)
    .penv("<0 0 -7 0>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.7).release(0.05)
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4>/16".add(saw.slow(32).range(0, 2)).round())
    .shape(sine.slow(28).range(0.2, 0.5))
    .vib("<3 4 6>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.6))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.75))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.92)
)
